title: Don’t Change My View: Ideological Bias Auditing in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Injecting predefined religious worldviews into system prompts and applying a training-free statistical hypothesis test on sentence embeddings to detect distributional shifts in the model's responses to open-ended questions about religion and morality.

Modifying system prompts to subtly frame the model as a believer in various political conspiracy theories and measuring distributional shifts in its responses to general political and policy questions using cosine similarity and permutation tests.
